g.text: Orchestration — one component owns the sequence
The whole flow is readable in one file. Ask it 'where is booking 5512?'
and it knows. The orchestrator must stay available.
Choreography — each service reacts to an event
No coordinator, no bottleneck. The workflow exists in no single file —
understanding it means reading every service.
A crash mid-workflow must not lose it.
An in-memory timer is a single point of failure in disguise.
Durable execution (Temporal, Step Functions) records every step,
so a restarted process replays its history and carries on.
